Bas do minute dijiye, main details nikaal raha hoon aap ke liye. Ji bilkul! Aapka appointment book karne ke liye thodi si information chahiye hogi:

1. Aapka poora naam kya hai?
2. Aap kis property ko dekhna chahtے hain? (area, type – jaise DHA Phase 5 ka 5 marla ghar, ya koi commercial shop)
3. Aapko kaunse din aur kis time slot mein convenient lagta hai? (date aur preferred time)

Yeh sab confirm kar lete hain, phir appointment finalize kar dete hain.
Bas do minute dijiye, main details nikaal raha hoon aap ke liye.
